title: Heyting arithmetic and constructive induction

based_on.title: From Constructive Mathematics to Computable Analysis via the Realizability Interpretation (doctoral thesis)
The Proof Theory of Classical and Constructive Inductive Definitions: A 40 year saga (Pohlersfest lecture, July 18, 2008)

summary: Develop native Heyting arithmetic, internal induction and equality decisions, finite numeral proofs, and exact correspondence of its classical extension with PA.
abstract: The equation two plus two equals four has a finite proof obtained by unrolling arithmetic equations. Induction turns a base case and a successor step into a statement about every number, and its logical rules determine what kind of conclusion that induction supplies. Heyting arithmetic keeps the usual first-order arithmetic axioms and full induction while using intuitionistic deduction. We construct its zero-or-successor alternatives, prove that arithmetic equality and every quantifier-free formula have decision disjunctions, and build explicit numeral proofs. Its classical extension agrees exactly with Peano arithmetic after the formula presentations are translated. The standard natural numbers validate all these constructive certificates, giving an external consistency argument.
